calls.statement:
SELECT 
  p.sku,
  p.product_name,
  SUM(f.quantity) as units_sold
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE f.store_key = 4
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND d.fiscal_period = 5
GROUP BY p.sku, p.product_name
ORDER BY units_sold DESC
LIMIT 3

-- Verify: check total units sold at Pitäjänmäki in P5 FY2026/27
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as line_count,
  SUM(f.quantity) as total_units
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE f.store_key = 4
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND d.fiscal_period = 5

SELECT 
  s.store_id,
  s.store_name,
  p.sku,
  p.product_name,
  SUM(f.quantity) as units_sold
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE f.store_key = 4
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND d.fiscal_period = 5
GROUP BY s.store_id, s.store_name, p.sku, p.product_name
ORDER BY units_sold DESC
LIMIT 3
